data.one_liner: TextField and TextFormField widgets providing address autocompletion using the Google Maps Places API.
data.what_it_does: Provides drop-in replacements for Flutter TextField and TextFormField widgets that perform address and location autocompletion using the Google Maps Places API. It handles querying suggestions and populating comprehensive place details into form fields.
use_when: You need users to input addresses using Google Maps Places autocomplete suggestions in a Flutter app.
You want to automatically populate multiple form fields (such as city, state, and zip code) from a selected address.
avoid_when: You need a full-screen interactive map view rather than text input autocompletion.
You use a mapping backend other than Google Places.
strengths: Supports both modern Places API (New) and legacy endpoints, plus custom backends.
Works across Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Offers options for securing your Google Maps API key via companion packages or proxy backends.
weaknesses: Requires a valid Google Maps API key and billing setup on Google Cloud.
API key security requires careful handling on client platforms to prevent abuse.
data.setup_notes: Requires enabling the Places API (New) on your Google Cloud project and supplying a Google Maps API key.
data.minimal_example:
AddressAutocompleteTextField(
    mapsApiKey: 'YOUR GOOGLE MAPS API KEY HERE',
    onSuggestionClick: onSuggestionClick,
    componentCountry: 'us',
    language: 'en-US'
)
